what: The season's machine as the introduction builds it (towers.T02-season), without its display.

code.note: packages/world as on main (base), plus the rig named here: the stations' own builders and frames from the frame data, with the rig's camera or the chapter's own

render.command: packages/world: sh scripts/serve.sh <port>, then node scripts/render.mjs --port <port> --frames _objects.tower-season --out <dir> --w 1280 --h 720 --scale 2 --plates 0 --raw --repeat 2
render.gpu: ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M1 Max

png_1280.size: 1280 x 720, render.mjs's Lanczos from the master

png_640.size: 640 x 360, ffmpeg's Lanczos from the master

rerender_when: the season tower (stations/towers/season.ts), the rig, or the frame data changes
